description: The frontier town square is a broad dusty street lined with timber storefronts. The two-storey Long Branch Saloon stands on the left, the Sheriff's Office is set farther back near the middle, and the Mackenzie General Store fills the right foreground. A church tower and a windmill rise behind the shops, with red hills beyond the town. Wooden porches, steps, barrels and crates edge the road. Lanterns hang on the shopfronts, and wagon equipment sits near the lower-left corner. The open central street makes the separate buildings easy to distinguish and leaves the routes between their porches visible.

landmarks.label: Dusty central street
landmarks.description: A broad dirt street passes between the porches, crates and barrels of the town.
